terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.sec1Body: By accessing or using Shine Studio ('the Service'), you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you disagree with any part of these terms, you may not access the Service.
terms.sec2Body: Shine uses generative AI models to create scripts and video content. You retain ownership of content you generate using the Service, subject to applicable AI usage policies.
terms.sec3Body: Shine offers Free, Pro, and Studio subscription tiers. Paid plans are billed monthly or annually. Credits are consumed per AI rendering generation.
terms.sec4Body: You may not use the Service to generate illegal, harmful, or copyright-infringing content.
terms.sec5Body: For questions regarding these terms, contact us at legal{'@'}shine.studio.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.sec1Body: We collect information you provide directly to us when creating an account, generating scripts, rendering vertical micro-drama episodes, or contacting support.
privacy.sec2Body: We use your information to operate, maintain, and improve our AI micro-drama production tools, personalize your workspace, and process subscription payments.
privacy.sec3Body: We implement industry-standard encryption and security measures to protect your personal account details and AI creative assets.
privacy.sec4Body: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact privacy{'@'}shine.studio.
